name: Academic Research Skills (ARS-Codex)
description: Comprehensive academic research workflow suite replicating ARS-Codex: 10-stage lifecycle orchestration, Socratic RQ guidance, 3W literature matrix, official Crossref DOI verification, 7-category integrity gates, claim-faithfulness alignment, scholarly tone calibration, multi-perspective peer review, and rebuttal coaching. Ready out of the box with zero private key requirements.
whenToUse: Use throughout the scholarly research lifecycle: research topic formulation, PRISMA systematic literature reviews, manuscript drafting, academic integrity auditing, multi-perspective mock peer reviews, point-by-point rebuttal letters, and publication formatting.

pipeline_stage_orchestrator.description: ARS 10-stage pipeline orchestrator: diagnose current research phases, issue Material Passports (evidence-chain audit records), chart sequential next steps, and enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

socratic_research_guide.description: Socratic research mentor & RQ blueprint builder: multi-turn heuristic dialogue refining broad concepts into rigorous scientific questions, scored via FINER criteria with candidate hypotheses.

verify_doi.description: Validate paper DOIs via the Crossref REST API to verify scholarly authenticity, extracting titles, authors, journals, publication years, citation counts, and abstracts to block AI hallucinations. No API key required.

search_crossref.description: Search the official Crossref repository by keyword, title, or author to retrieve registered papers with verified DOIs and bibliographic metadata, eliminating fabricated citations.

three_way_lit_scan.description: 3W literature matrix scanner (Why problem/gap, How methodology/controls, What findings/bounds) synthesizing cross-study consensus, theoretical debates, and open research gaps.

academic_integrity_audit.description: Pre-review and pre-submission academic integrity gate (Stage 2.5 / 4.5): audit manuscripts against 7 structural failure modes (hallucinated references, overclaiming, baseline flaws, statistical errors, etc.).

academic_paper_analysis.description: Structured scholarly literature analyzer: decompose abstracts, methods, or core passages across key dimensions (objectives, hypotheses, methodology, evidence chains, novelty, and limitations) for systematic research synthesis.

claim_citation_alignment.description: Claim-faithfulness (L3) verification: cross-check manuscript assertions against cited source findings to detect out-of-context citations and ungrounded claims.

academic_style_audit.description: Academic style calibration & formulaic prose elimination: audit and eliminate hollow buzzwords (delve, testament to), vague quantifiers, and unsubstantiated superlatives while preserving the author's scholarly voice.

peer_review_evaluation.description: Multi-perspective peer review simulation: evaluate manuscript validity, theoretical novelty, and methodological rigor from the perspectives of Editor-in-Chief, methodology reviewers, and Devil's Advocate using a 0-100 rubric.

rebuttal_matrix_coach.description: Point-by-point rebuttal matrix coach: decompose reviewer critique into structured revision matrices, guiding evidence additions, empirical revisions, and line-by-line response letters.

author_disclosure_statement.description: CRediT author contribution and ethics disclosure generator: create formalized Contributor Roles Taxonomy statements, AI assistance statements, and conflict of interest declarations aligned with major journal policies.

bibtex_format_converter.description: Bibliographic format converter & BibTeX normalizer: convert publication metadata or freeform references into standard BibTeX entries and APA 7.0 citations.
